improvedPrompt:
[IMPROVED_PROMPT]

I require you to function as a professional title generator for written content. I will deliver to you the specific topic and key words of an article, and your task is to craft five highly engaging, attention-grabbing titles that capture the essence of the piece. Please maintain the following strict guidelines:

1. Keep each title concise and to the point, ensuring it is no more than 20 words in length.
2. Preserve the meaning and substance of the original topic in every title you create.
3. Adapt your language style to match the tone and voice of the provided topic.

For your first assignment, I am supplying the following topic:

"LearnData: A comprehensive knowledge base built on the VuePress framework, into which I have integrated all of my accumulated notes and articles, making it an invaluable and easily accessible resource both for my own use and for sharing with others."

Please generate five titles that meet these criteria and that effectively convey the content and purpose of this knowledge base system. Utilize the tone and style implied by the topic. Remember that these titles must be capable of capturing the reader's interest and accurately reflecting the subject matter.

When providing your titles, please list them clearly and concisely, with each title on a new line for clarity. Ensure that your response is well-structured and easy to read.

Begin crafting your titles, and feel free to be creative while adhering to the established parameters.
